lines.text: You got one sunrise today. The crew of the space station got fifteen or sixteen.
Because the station goes all the way around the planet about once every ninety-two minutes.
That takes a speed of around twenty-seven thousand seven hundred kilometres an hour.
Here's the strange part. The station isn't floating up there. It's falling, the whole time.
So why doesn't it ever hit the ground? The answer is a speed, and it's in the full video. The link's right here.
